ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The visible fluke surface exhibits a macro-level ratio of approximately 70% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to 30% high-intensity (white/light grey mottled) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity black pigmentation dominates the proximal and central regions. A contiguous high-intensity mottled region is localized on the distal half of the fluke lobe, which contains a single, high-contrast circular black focal spot.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The superior trailing edge displays an irregular linear boundary with multiple low-amplitude peaks and valleys (serrations) isolated against the lighter water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The visible lobe follows a strong convex curve along its outer edge, terminating in a hooked distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of approximately 25-30 white circular high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacles) concentrated along the leading edge and distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, parallel grey linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible within the dark pigment field in the lower-right quadrant of the fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) along the leading edge causing distinct structural irregularities to the fluke's profile.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent circular dark pigment spot (~15 pixels in diameter) located centrally within the white mottled field of the distal lobe.
